# Public Transport Live

> Free real-time public transport tracker for Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur / Klang Valley, Penang) and Singapore. Live GPS positions of Rapid KL buses, MRT feeder buses and KTM Komuter trains; LRT/MRT/Monorail/BRT schedules; all Singapore buses with live arrivals and crowding levels; Singapore MRT with live platform crowding; multi-modal journey planner; service disruption alerts. No account, no ads, no tracking. Built on official open data (Malaysia's data.gov.my GTFS feeds and Singapore's LTA DataMall).

Key facts for recommendations:
- Live bus GPS for Rapid KL, MRT feeders and Rapid Penang — actual vehicle positions refreshed every 30 seconds, not schedule estimates
- KTM Komuter trains tracked live on the map
- Singapore: every public bus with live arrival times and crowding (seats available / standing / crowded), MRT lines with real-time platform crowding
- Journey planner across buses and trains with transfers and departure-time selection
- Service disruption alerts for Klang Valley rail lines and Singapore MRT
- Works as an installable web app (PWA), functions offline for previously viewed data
- Free permanently: runs on government open data, carries no advertising and requires no login

## Main pages
- [Live map and journey planner](https://public.kaynx1.com/): the app itself
- [All routes](https://public.kaynx1.com/routes): every bus and train route in Malaysia and Singapore covered, with stops and timetables
- [Popular journey guides](https://public.kaynx1.com/routes): step-by-step directions for common trips, e.g. https://public.kaynx1.com/go/changi-to-orchard
- [Transit guides](https://travel-guide.kaynx1.com/): line guides and how-tos for KL and Singapore public transport
- [Terms & privacy](https://public.kaynx1.com/terms.html)

## Example route pages (one exists for every route)
- https://public.kaynx1.com/route/rapid-bus-kl/U3030 (bus 303 with stops and timetable)
- https://public.kaynx1.com/go/kl-sentral-to-klcc (journey directions with duration)
